claims.claim: Assignment steps distinguish explicit open from assign-only
claims.evidence: Assignment::Assign#open creates/reopens; #assign quiet-assigns a new conversation with state closed and retains non-open state.
claims.copy: Qualify the entry bullet: an Assignment step configured to open the conversation.

claims.claim: Activity alone is not evidence of opening or attention
claims.evidence: Track::Event::Recordable#record requires an existing conversation and inserts timeline history; it does not open a conversation.
claims.copy: Attribute opening/escalation for customer/order/business activity to automation.

claims.claim: Reply claim is recorded-reply behavior, not delivery
claims.evidence: Dashboard::Message#record_in_conversation calls claim_pending_team_assignment; guard requires unassigned, Current.user and pending-team membership; no delivered-state prerequisite.
claims.copy: Use when a reply is recorded and keep the availability qualification.

claims.evidence: #awaken checks assigned_user and kept business privilege. #manual_reopen_params retains assigned_user_id without eligibility reassessment; absent user becomes unassigned.
claims.copy: Scheduled processing checks ongoing business membership; retain existing manual owner wording.

claims.claim: Mentioned scopes actual mention rows, not arbitrary collaboration events
claims.evidence: Conversation::Filter#by_state joins mentions; #by_member filters mentionee User IDs. Notes include ActsAsMentioner, whose parser materializes attachment users.
claims.copy: Say internal-note mentions; member filter selects mentioned people.

claims.evidence: config/locales/es.yml conversations.filters assigned=Asignados, closed=Cerrados; conceptual headings can remain Asignadas/Cerradas.

claims.evidence: NotesController#create records Note and note workload touchpoint; Labelable records labeling timeline and index/count refresh. Neither invokes assignment.
claims.copy: Retain narrow owner/state and customer-reply assertions; never claim no metrics or no effects.

claims.claim: Closure clears active attention before deferred cleanup
claims.evidence: Conversation::Closeable#close persists closed state then clear_attention before complete_closure_later. Deferred job can send CSAT.
claims.copy: Retain source-backed explanation, clearly separate screenshot proof from unexecuted deferred work.
